title: Annotatio VI §.I Prior Class Mode: Peaceful treatment; less-fundamental controversy so fraternal charity remains
pass_a_gloss: The Mode of treating: peaceful and such as befits; a Theological Controversy held by both contending parties to be less fundamental, so that room may remain for fraternal and Christian charity.
pass_b_english: The mode is peaceful — the kind that fits a theological fight.
Both parties treat the controversy as less than fundamental, so fraternal Christian charity still has room.
source_text: Modum tractandi placidum & qualis decet, Controversiam Theologicam ab utraque contendentium parte habitam minus fundamentalem, ut scilicet charitati fraternae Christianaeque locus maneat reliquus.
notes: Placid mode; minus fundamentalem; fraternal charity.
